new_learnings.text: When breadth is 0.31:1 and only 1 of 3 major indices is green, the correct momentum action is to hold cash even if a few semiconductor names are working.
new_learnings.mechanism: Weak market internals overwhelm isolated stock strength; forcing entries in a panic tape reduces follow-through odds.

new_learnings.text: The MA-distance anti-chase filter is doing heavy lifting again today: many of the strongest candidates are in hot sectors but still unbuyable because they are too far above MA5/MA10/MA20.
new_learnings.mechanism: Momentum works best when buying strength near support, not after vertical extensions that raise mean-reversion risk.

new_learnings.text: A fresh position can stay HOLD even after a -4.38% day if it remains above the hard stop, but weak volume should immediately downgrade any idea of adding capital.
new_learnings.mechanism: Price has not invalidated the trade yet, but sub-MAVOL participation signals weak demand and lowers odds of an immediate rebound.
